name: read_pull_request
description: Read a Bitbucket pull request (commands have no network; this does). Give pr (its link), or repo and branch to find the open pull request from that branch (found: false if there is none). Returns title, state, source and destination branch, the source commit and the changed files with their line counts. With file: that file's diff only (up to 16,000 characters).

repo.description: Without a link: workspace/repo as in the origin URL, e.g. acme/payments

branch.description: Without a link: the source branch, e.g. feature/PROJ-16765-limits

file.description: A changed file's path, to get its diff; empty for the pull request and its file list
